name: Rafiq Uddin Ahmed
contribution: He joined the demonstration defying Section 144 and was shot dead during police firing on 21 February 1952.
context: Dhaka Medical College Hostel premises, 21 February 1952.
impact: He became one of the most enduring names through which Ekushey is remembered across generations.
highlight: Rafiq Uddin Ahmed was shot dead on 21 February 1952 during protests demanding recognition of Bangla.
seoTitle: Rafiq Uddin Ahmed: Language Martyr of 1952
seoDescription: Learn about Rafiq Uddin Ahmed's death during the 21 February 1952 Language Movement protests and his place in Ekushey memory.
shortAnswer: Rafiq Uddin Ahmed was a protester killed by police firing on 21 February 1952 during the Language Movement in Dhaka.
